github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Never use Conventional Commit prefixes. Do not start the subject with feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, style, test, build, ci, perf or any 'type:' or 'type(scope):' pattern.
Write the subject in sentence case and imperative mood, under 72 characters, with no trailing period.
Always include a body. Leave one blank line after the subject, then list changes as '- ' bullets.
Write one bullet per meaningful change. Name the files, classes or functions involved and say what changed and why. Prefer several specific bullets over one vague sentence.
Call out user-visible behaviour changes, new or renamed files, changes to persisted data or file formats, and build script changes. Describe only what the diff actually contains.
